reviews.x: Oh no!  This is certainly not the original product!  I know this because I have a bottle that I bought at the salon that is the original. This product is totally different!  The smell is horrendous and not at all like the original.  This shampoo is goopy and Has a gelatin consistency.  I was looking forward to having this delivered to my door and using it. I don’t know where all of these stellar reviews came from!  This is going back for sure!  Back to the salon I go from now on for this product

Best shampoo on the market. My hair is very fine/limp. After using this my hair is full, shiny, bouncy and no static. The conditioner is great to, doesn't make my hair greasy or weigh my hair down. Update 26 days later=I'm returning the shampoo, my hair has become lifeless and waxy feeling. All the volume has disappeared after use. Very disappointed.
LOve  this shampoo. I have baby fine hair and it really does give you volume.

Gray hair was becoming limp and fly a way.  A Sephora worker recommended this shampoo to me.  And wow, it really added volume to my hair.  For continuous days which I wanted.  Expensive but you do not need to double wash your hair even after a week.  This will last, which cuts down on cost and definitely improve hair quality and look.

I like many things about this product: it's great that you don't have to use very much, that it makes my hair look and feel good. However, on the second day after using (I wash my har every other day), my hair feels (and looks, I fear) greasy. For what this product costs, that shouldn't be. I'm on the fence about whether I'll buy it again.

In the summer, I air dry my mildly natural curly hair which gives me fullness.  But during the Chicago winters, I need something to give my hair more body.  I have several cheaper volumizing shampoos, but this one seems to work the best.  It also doesn't dry out my hair, like some volumizing shampoos can do.  It's expensive ($27 for 8 ounces), but since I only wash my hair every three days, the bottle lasts awhile and subsequently reasonable.

I love living proof for my chemically processed, baby fine hair. It does make it feel thicker and more resilient.  It's expensive, but a little tiny bit goes a very long way, so I use much less of the product than I do any other, so it lasts a long time. That's why I gave it a good review for value.
I use this shampoo all the time.  I think it’s a little pricey.  I like it, and don’t need to use a lot for my short bob length.

Maybe it was the marketing? Maybe it was the description? Whatever it was, I was excited to try this brand for the first time. What a disappointment. Shampoos at Walmart do as well. Bummer. Sorry to say I won't buy it again. Ever.
This product has a weird smell and doesn’t make my hair feel nicer than any regular shampoo. I don’t believe this is actually Living Proof product.
I can’t buy this product any more.  It totally tangled my hair, leaving a sticky residue.  I think the products composition has been changed.
I mean it’s just not worth the money at all. Didn’t make my hair feel thicker. Left it feeling like It had a weird film and I had to wash my hair again.

reviews.t: Buy this if you want to say goodbye to your hair
reviews.x: Please, in the name of all things pure and good, DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT. I wish I had listened to all the reviews of people who experienced hair loss/damage after using this shampoo. I wish I had listened to my scalp that would always get red and irritated and flakey. I wish I had taken a warning after fishing out clumps of hair from my Tub Shroom after every wash, picking up chunks of hair scattered all around my apartment, and finding tons of hair on my wide tooth comb after one stroke throug

reviews.t: If your hair gets dry- do not use this!!!!
reviews.x: If your hair gets the tiniest bit dry DO NOT use this shampoo! Or use it sparingly. While it gives volume, it will literally cause it to break and come out. I was using this for weeks and started realizing my hair was starting to break and coming out so much. I Asked my hair stylist about this and said it was probably way to drying for my hair and causing the breakage, since nothing else had changed otherwise concerning my hair.

reviews.t: Maybe buy a smaller size to try on hair
reviews.x: For some reason, this product made my scalp itch like crazy and lose hair. I've used the conditioner alone with no issues, so I am not entirely sure if it was combining them together? I may just have a sensitive scalp, but any other drugstore hair products usually work fine for me. But it did deliver volume, so if your scalp can brave the feeling, it is nice.

This shampoo (along with the matching conditioner) has completely transformed my hair. Until now, I always felt like washing my fine, long hair was a chore and hated the look and feel of newly clean hair. Everything has changed with this shampoo, and I am in love. I have tried it all— from drug store brands to the most popular luxury brand shampoos— and nothing has held a candle to this stuff. I am very pleased with Living Proof full shampoo! I have been using the shampoo for over a month and I have fine hair. My hair has transformed from being stringy and dull to full and shiny, especially in the morning my hair is no longer oily which I have been dealing with for a long. time. After deciding to let my hair grow is when I made the decision to leave the Aveda line to Living Proof as trying to grow my hair out Aveda left it a stingy mess full of oil. My hair is now just past my shoulde

reviews.x: This grey haired lady is hopeful she’ll feel the same way on Day 2. One shampoo in and my hair feels like I’ve stepped out of the salon. Full, soft, with body and shine, and all from using one pea size of shampoo and conditioner! Will try to update this post after a while to let you all know how it works for me long term. I am a Grandma in my 70's and found this is the perfect shampoo for me forever. I continually order it from Amazon because of the price I have very fine hair and this gives me the lift I need for my hair. i get compliments on my hair and it even shines. My hair turned out a nice silver late in life and I am so happy this product that it makes me easy to take care of my hair. Thank you for  making it.......

I am a complete convert to Living Proof products. When the bottle first arrived, I thought, “whoa, pricey for the size!” I have changed my mind. Over two months later, I still have about 25% of the shampoo left. You don’t have to wash your hair every day! First time in my life!
Exactly what I have been looking for!  Does everything it claims.  It is quite expensive but it works and that is what is most important to me.
This shampoo really helps keep my hair healthy. As I age and medications were ruining my hair this product has really helped.
Wouldn’t buy again. I have fine hair & I didn’t see a difference after using the products multiple times.
A bit pricey, but great volume & fullness and rinses very well. Will buy again.
Nice shampoo.  You don't need a lot.  I keep buying it so I really do like it.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the shampoo adds volume and body, especially for fine or limp hair.
Several reviewers find it expensive, though some note a little goes a long way so it lasts.
Some reviewers report negative effects like dryness, breakage, hair loss, or scalp irritation.
A few reviewers complain of a bad smell, greasy or waxy residue, or suspect the formula is not genuine or has changed.
Some reviewers say it did not work for them or was not worth the money.
